policy.title: Cancellation, Reschedule & Refund Policy
policy.intro: Every confirmation message includes a secure link to reschedule or cancel your appointment — no account needed.
policy.reschedule: is possible up to {hours} hours before your slot, subject to availability. Within {hours} hours of a confirmed appointment, please contact the clinic directly.
policy.cancel: release your slot immediately so another patient can book it. Confirmed appointments can be cancelled online up to {hours} hours before the start time.
policy.refundIntro: All payments are processed securely through Razorpay. Where a refund is due, it is returned to the original payment method.
policy.refundSource: Approved refunds are credited back to the same card, UPI, bank account or wallet you paid from — they cannot be redirected elsewhere.
policy.refundTime: Once approved, refunds typically reach your account within 5–7 working days, depending on your bank.
policy.refundAuto: If your payment succeeds but the slot was taken in the meantime, the full amount is refunded automatically and you'll be invited to rebook — no payment is ever lost.
policy.refundDiscretion: Refunds for cancellations are considered by the clinic on a case-by-case basis.
policy.footerNote: This is a general policy; the doctor may accommodate genuine emergencies at her discretion.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of this website and the consultation services offered through it. By booking an appointment or otherwise using the site, you agree to these terms.

acceptance.heading: Who we are & acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: This site is operated by ARYA, a homoeopathy clinic and consultancy led by Dr. Seema Prajapati (BHMS). By accessing the site or booking a consultation, you confirm that you have read, understood and accepted these terms.

services.heading: Services
services.body: We offer online and in-clinic homoeopathic consultations, booked through this site, at our Pune and Nagpur locations. Consultations are advisory healthcare services and are not a substitute for emergency care. In a medical emergency, please contact your local emergency services or nearest hospital immediately.

appointments.heading: Appointments & payments
appointments.body: Appointment slots are confirmed only after a successful payment made through our payment partner, Razorpay. Fees are those displayed at the time of booking. Until payment is received, a slot is not reserved.

cancellation.heading: Cancellation, reschedule & refunds
cancellation.body: Cancellations, rescheduling and refunds are governed by our <policyLink>Cancellation & Refund Policy</policyLink>. Please review it before booking.

telemedicine.heading: Telemedicine consent
telemedicine.body: Online consultations are conducted in line with applicable Indian telemedicine practice guidelines. By choosing an online consultation, you consent to receive care remotely and confirm that the information you provide is accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge.

medicines.heading: Medicines
medicines.body: Where medicines are dispensed or couriered, any stated delivery timelines are estimates and may vary. Please use all medicines only as directed.

privacy.heading: Privacy
